description: MERIDIAN.md claims secret/destructive rules are blocked at the commit/CI boundary, but meridian-verify.sh never scans file contents; content rules only fire on agent tool calls. A key committed from an editor would pass.

note: Increment 3 (2026-10-02 and 03): time on Meridian itself, gates, checks, hooks, evaluator prep; Chris's figure

description: literature_ready passed with 4 claims (of about 42 across three sections) that the final literature audit then failed: sentences that state a source's finding and add the review's own comparison or caveat under the same citation. The synthesis gate's one judge verdict per claim let them through; the judge also flipped between asks on borderline claims (credal-dro needed 3 repair passes).

audit3_ready passed and froze an audit that false-fails any paper whose dataset name contains an underscore (the table check reads the dataset back from its lower-cased column label). Found only when a real loop run used extension datasets named analytical_rho0; worked around by renaming the datasets, not editing the frozen audit.

A claim's quote can support only part of its sentence while the judge is shown the whole passage, so a green literature audit does not mean every clause is anchored to a quote (an independent reviewer found this in several llm-judge-numbers claims, verified for R20, R46, R23). Gates literature_ready and audit3_ready check quote-in-passage and judge-on-passage, not clause-by-clause linkage.

note: 2026-10-03: Increment 4 carry-in, topics, literature v2, feasibility
